supervision.reason: Attempt 1: All four requirements are addressed in the code: R1 and R4 share the entries list/total logic in entries.mjs and the e2e suite, R2 is covered by projects.mjs, store.mjs, time.mjs, and the button-type fix in time.html, and R3 is covered by the egg header in time.html; the only gap is that no change explicitly names R4, though it is almost certainly handled as the empty-state branch of the R1 code.

assessment.reason: Supervision confirmed the first attempt served its broad requirement (R1/R2/R3/R4 logic present), but three of the four observed changes were judged DoesNotServe: R4's empty-state text isn't independently visible, the probe file took five iterations to neutralize, and the styles.css reduction (101→7 lines) is unconfirmed as safe. The core logic appears in place, but the unverified style removal and the non-trivial probe churn leave meaningful doubt about whether the changes fully served the order.
